title: Record a verification level on each unit so implemented is not read as verified
scope: Add a verification field to unit files with ordered levels (none, fixed-corpus, fuzzed, coverage-reviewed) and require the top level for accepted. The status table and next_task.py show the level.
acceptance: Plan checker rejects accepted without the top level and rejects a level its evidence does not support; selftest includes the mutations.

Existing implemented units are labelled from qualifying evidence: four PLY/STL parser child units are fuzzed with retained exact-candidate campaigns; native differential units are at least fixed-corpus. Tooling without a qualifying retained run stays none.
resolved_items: 2026-11-03: explicit independent levels on all108 units; evidence support/integrity validation, accepted gate, generated status and task display.
Retained29 passing positive/negative tooling controls; fresh6000-input normal PLY/STL campaign plus corruption payloads, no ordinary divergence.
